label.purpose: Field/column labels inside data, never above a heading.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Hero content's one authored entrance moment; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid gold CTA, used once per screen for the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c9a24b; color: #1a1408; border: none; border-radius: 2px; padding: 14px 28px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e4c479; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9a24b; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CTA, used in the header.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #c9a24b; border: 1px solid #c9a24b; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #c9a24b; color: #1a1408; }

components.name: Option Row
components.description: Selectable row for service/barber choice in the booking flow; the row itself is the control, no separate radio.
components.css: .ds-option-row { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(201,162,75,0.16); border-radius: 2px; padding: 12px 16px; color: #f3efe6; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-option-row:hover { border-color: rgba(201,162,75,0.32); } .ds-option-row--selected { border-color: #c9a24b; background: #151513; } .ds-option-row__title { display: block; font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; } .ds-option-row__meta { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #c9c2b2; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Name/phone fields in the booking summary form.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(201,162,75,0.16); border-radius: 2px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #f3efe6; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #c9c2b2; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #c9a24b; }

components.name: Calendar Day Cell
components.description: Circular day cell in the hand-built month calendar; the one circular exception to the system's 2px-radius default.
components.css: .ds-cal-day { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #f3efe6; background: transparent; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-cal-day:hover { background: rgba(201,162,75,0.16); } .ds-cal-day--selected { background: #c9a24b; color: #1a1408; } .ds-cal-day--disabled { color: rgba(201,194,178,0.3); }

components.name: Hero Photo
components.description: Right-weighted photographic hero treatment: desaturated/brightened real photo, directional ink gradient for text legibility, 105% hover zoom.
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-hero__img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 38% 32%; filter: grayscale(0.1) brightness(1.05) saturate(1.05); transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-hero:hover .ds-hero__img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-hero__scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to left, #0b0b0c, rgba(11,11,12,0.55), transparent); }

narrative.overview: The template reads as a members' barbershop that keeps its own leather-bound ledger, not a bright SaaS booking widget. A near-black charcoal ground carries everything; a single warm brass/gold accent is spent deliberately, never scattered. A serif display face gives headlines the weight of a letterpress sign, while a plain geometric sans keeps the working parts legible and quiet. Separation comes from thin gold hairlines and negative space, not boxes or shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, one gold accent, nothing else competes for attention
Serif display (Fraunces) for headlines, geometric sans (Inter) everywhere functional
Hairline rules and whitespace replace cards and shadows as the separation device
Flat throughout — no elevation, no blur, no gradients beyond the hero photo's darkening overlay
The hero carries the template's one real photograph, desaturated and darkened into the palette rather than shown at full color

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only saturated color in the system. A new element earns gold or stays in paper/paper-dim — never a second hue.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker line ever sits above a heading. Uppercase tracked labels are used only as field/column labels inside data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. A selected or active element gets a gold border and/or the ink-raised fill, never a shadow.

dos: Do spend gold on exactly one thing per view: the primary action, the active state, or the price.
Do separate content with gold-tinted hairlines and whitespace, not boxes or shadows.
Do keep all business content sourced from site_config/services/barbers — never hardcode a shop's identity into a component.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow line above any heading.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, a card-grid scaffold, or any box-shadow.
Don't invent customer-facing claims (ratings, testimonials, years of experience) not backed by real data.
